en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a small decorative wooden bridge over a pond in a lush botanical garden. Dense tropical and subtropical plants surround the water, with large agaves or similar plants in the foreground. A person is seated on the middle of the bridge. Below the image is a printed caption and descriptive paragraph in Portuguese, and the right half of the card is left blank for writing or an address.
